4.24.3 takes everything in [4.24.2](/releases/hotloop-4-24-2/) to every board we ship for: Shelly of every generation, ONVIF cameras, Arduinos over Firmata, OPC UA passwords of any length, a forward queue that empties behind a slow link, `--version` that names its commit, and a default HotLoop Edge install that starts.

The Gateway runs on amd64 and arm64, and Edge, IoT and the Edge Relay run on amd64, arm64 and arm/v7, so the same release covers your servers, your Pis and your older ARM gateways. Read [4.24.2's notes](/releases/hotloop-4-24-2/) for everything new since 4.24.0.

- All four charts (`hotloop`, `hotloop-iot`, `hotloop-edge`, `hotloop-edge-relay`) are at 4.24.3, with every earlier version still in the index.
- Upgrade the way you always do: a `helm upgrade` to the 4.24.3 chart, or the new tag in your Quadlet unit. Nothing needs migrating.
